title: Unify Sketchpad Panel Toggles With Elements UI
description: Refactor sketchpad so the navbar only exposes left and right panel toggles, matching elements/ui. Remove dedicated settings/chat navbar toggles and route settings/chat through right-side tabs only. Update the existing sketchpad Playwright tests in place to match the new model and verify the affected app flows.
summary: Refactored sketchpad to match elements/ui by keeping only left and right navbar panel toggles and rendering settings/chat as regular right-side tabs. Removed sketchpad’s dedicated utility panel mode switching, simplified right-side panel activation logic, updated right-side tab expectations in the existing Playwright suite, and verified the sketchpad bundle still builds and the test file still discovers six app-level tests.
